## Finding

On r17176 the function in the ticket compiles to 26 bytes for mcs51 with the command line of the
ticket. This is the size that the ticket gives for 3.6.9. The code has no instruction on `r5` or
`r6`, so the three dead instructions that the ticket reports for 3.9.1 are absent. Without
`--opt-code-size` the code is identical. The first comment reports that the defect does not occur
in 4.6.0.

The revision after which the instructions are absent was not identified. No commit in trunk names
the ticket, and the ticket has no listing from 3.9.1 to compare with.

## Related

The two patches in the comments add peephole rules to `src/mcs51/peeph.def`, numbered 266.c,
266.d, and 139.d to 139.f. Trunk does not have these rules. The code from r17176 contains the
sequences that they match. `reg` is loaded into `a` a second time after `jnb acc.0`, and
`mov r7,a` precedes `xrl ar7,#0xe1`. The patches were not applied or tested here.
